featured_reviews.name: Soniii
featured_reviews.review_text:
Today I visited RJ Family Restaurant & Bar. The restaurant has a decent and average ambiance. It is okay for family dining, but nothing feels premium or special. Seating and overall atmosphere were fine.
Coming to the food, the quality was average and the taste was not good. There was no special flavor at all, and the dishes felt very basic. Considering the expectations, the food did not impress us.
Overall, it was an average experience. The ambiance is okay, but the food taste really needs improvement. If the restaurant works on food quality and taste, it can become a better place to visit.

featured_reviews.review_text: Visited RJ Family Restaurant & Bar today with my wife—bar section was packed, so they seated people in the family area. featured_reviews.review_text: Wonderful food quality and so many varieties of food including starters, main course, desserts. featured_reviews.name: Ashita Agrawal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited here for dinner and my experience was really good.

Located right outside the Virar West station, this is a mid luxury restaurant with poush ambience which is rare to find in Virar.

The concept here is very different. It is a self service restaurant with a very short but apt menu. The staff here is very humble and helping staff.

One thing that I really loved was the prices are very very pocket friendly and every item on the menu is available in S, M, L size. You can order as per your appetite instead of wasting food & money.

About the food, here's what all I tried -

Beverage:
Lemon Iced Tea & Paan Iced Tea - Both were very refreshing and the flavors were perfect. Loved the paan iced tea more because i am a paan fan.

Starters:
Cajun Spiced French Fries - Marinated and fried in cajun spices, It was served in a popcorn paper box which really looked very tempting. Loved the way it was presented. Taste was just superb.

Bhuna Paneer Spring Roll - very soft & crumbly paneer in bhuna masala was stuffed in spring roll sheets and deep fried served along with sweet chili dip. Tastes Really good. This dish has nothing to do with spring roll, its just the sheet they have used.

Main Course:

Hakka Noodles - This is one of the best picks in main course i feel. Simply too delicious. Perfectly tossed along with veggies. The portion size is really good too.

Crispy Veg in Shanghai Gravy - This was marinated veggies deep fried and added to a sweet and spicy gravy. Taste was really good. Really loved the portion size of this dish.

All in all, the dishes here are really good. Portion sizes are great and too pocket friendly.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you so much for your kind words, Ashita! 🌸 We’re delighted to hear that you had a great dining experience with us. Your support means a lot, and we can’t wait to welcome you back soon at Viva Utsav Pure Veg for another wonderful meal! 🍽️🙏

Thank you for your wonderful 5-star review! 😊
We’re delighted to know that you enjoyed our pure vegetarian food and appreciated our unique concept. We’re also glad you found our location convenient near Virar West station.

Your kind words truly motivate our team to keep delivering a great experience.

We look forward to welcoming you again soon!

Warm regards,
Team Viva Utsav Pure Veg

featured_reviews.review_text:
Hello friends, The food taste here is value for money. As I am a regular customer here visiting for takeaways but today what I saw felt regret for ordering from this place. That's why just sharing with you all & also to the Meals & Reels owner (Hope he can put some effort on hygiene part) I do understand that maybe in most restaurant this thing is common as customers cannot see in kitchen how they cook or pack the food. But today when I ordered Rice with gravy as takeaway. As the kitchen is open where they cook and pack parcel. ONE OF THE KITCHEN STAFF LITERALLY WITHOUT ANY HESITATION PUT HIS HAND (no plastic gloves or cap on his head as matter of hygiene) IN THE FRIED RICE & ATE ONE BIG HELPING WHILE PACKING IT FOR ME. It's so bad feeling that some stranger putting hand in your food which is already in the packing container and eating & for which you are paying.

I was just thinking maybe that kitchen staff without hesitation while serving or from takeaways might be putting his hand to eat in all those many customers ordering online, offline, dine-in.

Owner feel free to contact me if you want to know who that guy was as I am not bluffing. The Owner and the Manager (If any) over there should take care of the hygiene part.

P.S - I threw my parcel in the dustbin as I was not feeling to eat that food & I don't felt to give any needy also that kind of food. And I don't wish to take the risk due to their hygiene issue by asking to give me a fresh exchange order.

featured_reviews.review_text: Ordered  Chicken Tandoori Biryani 1 Kg and was home delivered, honestly i have never eaten such tasteless Biryani ever, the chicken pieces doesn' feel like its been tandoor and are larger than normal. If someone is looking for typically hotel Biryani which is also tawa biryani (ripped of from spices and burned), only then order from here but for those who crave for a proper biryani then please find a good biryani house/biryani caterers who will provide you biryani in proper briyani deg and not in a plastic container which was served to me, Thank You
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Shlok,
Thank you for sharing your feedback. We’re sorry that our Chicken Tandoori Biryani did not match your expectations.
We would like to clarify that our biryani is prepared in our own traditional hotel-style method, which is different from street-style Deg Biryani. Taste preferences can vary from person to person, and sometimes this difference in style may not suit everyone.
We always use fresh ingredients, proper marination, and hygienic preparation methods. Regarding packaging, we use sealed food-grade containers to ensure safe delivery.
Regarding the chicken pieces, we use full fresh tandoori chicken, which is prepared first in the tandoor and then added to the biryani. Each full tandoori is cut into 8 pieces, which is why the pieces may appear larger than usual.
If there was any specific issue with your order, we would have been happy to resolve it immediately if you had contacted us.
We value your feedback and will continue working to improve. We hope to get an opportunity to serve you better in the future.
Warm regards,
Team Kebab House
